## `View`

trait in `choscorui::prelude::View`

```rust
pub trait View: 'static { /* items below */ }
```

A piece of user interface. A component implements [`View::body`](#viewbody) and
returns other views; the toolkit's primitive views (stacks, text,
controls) implement `View::mount` instead. `body` runs once, when the
component mounts.

### Items

#### `View::body`

```rust
fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx<'_>) -> impl View
```

The component's content.

#### `View::into_any`

```rust
fn into_any(self) -> AnyView
where
    Self: Sized,
```

The view with its type erased, for branches and component
boundaries.
